title: 12 Rules for Life: An Antidote to Chaos
author: Jordan B. Peterson
summary: Jordan Peterson offers twelve rules, such as standing up straight and telling the truth, mixing psychology, mythology and personal anecdote on responsibility and meaning.
readIf: you want an essay-style mix of advice and ideas on personal responsibility.
skipIf: you want concise, evidence-led self-help or find Peterson's views off-putting.
